title: Bruce Erickson's theory that Ransone was a spy

tellings.quote: speculates that she was sort of um like a spy and and the and the type

plain: A woman named Valerie Ransone may have been a kind of spy, according to a theory put forward by a man named Bruce Erickson about events in the 1970s. A researcher who comes on the show, and who is not named, passes the idea on from Erickson. The episode is about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an "alien council", and the researcher says Erickson "speculates that she was sort of um like a spy", without saying who she might have worked for or what she did. If it were so, her part in that story would look quite different.
